npp.fix: Shut down on 20 December 2019. Free of nuclear fuel since September 2023, after 418 fuel elements were moved to the interim store at Würenlingen in 66 transports, which removed over 99 % of the radioactivity on site. Nuclear dismantling is planned to be complete at the end of 2031 and the site released for other use from 2034. It no longer abstracts cooling water at operating volumes.
